walkthroughs.body_html:
Enterprise means spotting a chance and acting on it.

An entrepreneur is a person who turns an idea into a real business — like James Dyson with his vacuum or Anita Roddick with The Body Shop.

Enterprise needs three things: an idea, the courage to try, and customers who will pay. 💡

A market gap is something people want but cannot easily buy.

Good ways to spot a gap:

  • Listen to people complain.
  • Notice problems you face yourself.
  • See what other countries already sell.

If you can fix a real problem, you might have a winner.

Starting a business is risky. Most new businesses close within five years.

But the rewards can be huge — you are your own boss, you keep the profit, and you build something new.

Entrepreneurs weigh risk vs reward before they begin. ⚖️

mcqs.q: What is Taylor's theory of scientific management?
options: Workers are motivated primarily by money; efficiency is maximised by breaking tasks into standardised steps, training workers in 'the one best way', and using piece-rate pay.
Taylor said workers are motivated by recognition and teamwork.
Taylor invented the assembly line at Ford.

PESTLE analyses the internal strengths and weaknesses of a business.
The external macro-environment: Political, Economic, Social, Technological, Legal and Environmental factors affecting a business.
PESTLE stands for Profit, Earnings, Sales, Trade, Loans, Equity.

mcqs.q: How is Return on Capital Employed (ROCE) calculated?
options: PESTLE stands for Profit, Earnings, Sales, Trade, Loans, Equity.
ROCE is just net profit divided by revenue.

Operating profit divided by capital employed (total equity + non-current liabilities), expressed as a percentage. It measures how efficiently the business uses its long-term financing to generate profit.
ROCE is the wages divided by hours worked.
